why: Tests fix round of slice AS-no-unknown-parameters-3 (anti-slop judgment sweep, next/), on branch fabrikalfa/antislop-no-unknown-parameters-3 from 152006b with origin/main merged in (a clean merge, as step-rules.md asks), no pull request (owner ruling). The build narrowed the door's params from unknown to Schema.Json | undefined, and pnpm typecheck then failed only in next/apps/fabrika, in exam files that restate or feed the old unknown params. All fixed by hand edits; no quick fix, no codemod, no disable line, no lock line, no .oxlintrc.json change, no assertion deleted or narrowed. The build's saved patch gave five edits: door.integration.test.ts the route stand-in's params and the request helper's m, runtime-quotas.laws.test.ts input's m, runtime-recovery.laws.integration.test.ts route's params, start-child.test-support.ts letter's m. After it, 9 sites were left. checklist-instance.laws.integration.test.ts :505 (pid from a pick), :568, :575, :590, :636, :660 (pid from an array destructure): the two placings decodes now require a non-empty second list with Schema.NonEmptyArray, and the input move decodes its pick with Schema.String, so an absent pid fails the walk loudly. runtime-recovery.laws.integration.test.ts :1656: the live helper decodes the process with Schema.String, so a name with no live process throws, until polls again, and the restarted-process check now waits for a real process rather than passing on undefined. door.integration.test.ts :3578 and :3579, the p67 spoof law's MalformedStampedWrite generator: its message state is a Schema.JsonObject, a wrong field value and the stamp value are drawn from Schema.Json instead of Schema.Json | undefined, and a missing edit still deletes the key. This drops the stamp-is-undefined case from this one generator: no typed caller can send it any more and JSON cannot carry it; the lead should read it as a generator change. The p66 SpoofedWrite law still draws undefined stamps through spoofedParams' conditional spread, which TypeScript accepts as optional keys; left as it was.

plants.law: pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p next/apps/fabrika over the exam files
plants.plant: the tree with only the build's five-edit patch applied, before this round's edits
